posts.author: WorldsBetweenDev
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I found this forum when looking up resources and solutions for my RPG Maker MZ project. It seemed pretty informative and helpful so I thought I'd contribute as well as get feedback on some of my stuff when it's ready to show. As a lover of classic RPGs, I had been working on a novel inspired by them. It was then I realized why not make it an RPG itself? After several years of trying and failing to self teach myself art, music, and programming...I had nearly given up until I found RPG Maker. So now, several months in, I am ready to start peeling back a little of my game Worlds Between. While it is still wildly early and I'm closer to the start than I am finishing, I have put a few screenshots of my game's early development.
It's still early, and I'm learning a lot so I'm not ready to share too much of it yet, but I'm excited to get to know people and learn some more as I develop this. Thank you all for reading
this.
